item_desc7000032.en: A transparent branch floating in the air. No one knows where it came from, nor what its real name is. Speeds up the holder's cultivation process. A dream item for cultivators.
item_desc7000032.ch: 一截浮在空中的透明树枝，没有人知道它的来历也没有人知道它真正的名字。能增加持有者修炼的速度，修仙者梦寐以求的东西。

item_desc7000038.en: A book recording the unusual story that occurred on Mirage Island.
item_desc7000038.ch: 一本书记载着迷幻岛事件。

item_desc7000039.en: Can be used 9 times. After you use this item, all enemies will instantly receive high damage one time. For the next 9s, enemies will receive damage once per second. The damage amount will be equal to that of your left-click skill. During the 9s, enemies can't attack you.
item_desc7000039.ch: 可使用9次。使用后全屏敌人受到一次高伤害，之后每秒受到一次等同你左键技能的伤害，持续9秒，持续期间不能攻击你。

item_desc7000040.en: Fuxi's Rope is said to be a tool for Fuxi to store and pass down his memories. If you use this item during battle, you current status will be recorded. A 20s countdown will appear in the center of your screen. If you survive the 20s, your status will be restored to the recorded condition 20s ago. As it's only a replica, you can only use this item 3 times.
item_desc7000040.ch: 伏羲绳，相传伏羲用来传承记忆的神器。战斗中使用会记录你现在的状态，并在屏幕中间开启一个20秒的倒计时，如果你20秒内没有阵亡，则20秒后将你的状态恢复到记录时的状态。因为是仿制品所以只能使用3次。

item_desc7000041.en: Drink this to receive power! Use to increase your ATK and DEF by 20% for 3 months.
item_desc7000041.ch: 巨猿的血液。据说喝下它的人会变得勇猛无比。使用后增加20%攻击和防御，持续3个月。

item_desc7000042.en: This might help the girl balance out the cold aura in her heart.
item_desc7000042.ch: 说不定能帮助少女平衡心中的寒气。

item_desc7000045.en: A small notebook recording the incident at the River of No Return. Memorabilia from an Adventure.
item_desc7000045.ch: 一本记录了不归河事件的小册子。奇遇纪念。

item_desc7000046.en: The dream Elixir of all Cultivators. Getting it, however, relies on luck. Use to increase EXP.
item_desc7000046.ch: 所有的修仙者梦寐以求的丹药，能否得到全靠机缘。能增加一定量修为。

item_desc7000047.en: Use this item to summon the wronged ghost to attack enemies nearby for 15s.
item_desc7000047.ch: 召唤出冤魂攻击附近敌人，持续15秒。

item_desc7000048.en: This item absorbs the power from those who died in battle to boost its holder's stats. Each lost life increases your ATK and DEF by 2% (up to 40%) till the current battle ends. Using this item more than once doesn't stack this effect.
item_desc7000048.ch: 吸收战斗中的亡魂来增强持有者的属性，每个亡魂增加2%攻防，最多增加40%。持续整场战斗。不可叠加。

item_desc7000050.en: A dark mystic beast born in the abyss. As it devours all light in its surroundings, no one's really seen its true form besides its silhouette.
item_desc7000050.ch: 生长于深渊中的黑暗异兽，只能从周围被吞噬的光来判断其大致轮廓，没人看见过它真正的样子。

item_desc7000055.en: An empty knapsack you stumbled upon. Looks like it might belong to a ghost merchant.
item_desc7000055.ch: 你无意中发现的背囊，里面空无一物，看上去像是鬼魂商人的。

item_desc7000056.en: What looks like a poetry anthology compiled by a cultivator. As it's very old and not well-preserved, the majority of the text is impossible to decipher.
item_desc7000056.ch: 看着像是某位修道者自行编订的诗集，由于年代久远以及保护不当，其中绝大部分的内容已经分辨不清...

item_desc7000057.ch: 看着像是某位修道者自行编订的诗集，由于年代久远以及保护不当，其中绝大部分的内容已经分辨不清...

item_desc7000059.en: It is the spirit sword Yuanzhi always carried with her, only its owner was gone…
item_desc7000059.ch: 愿知随身携带的灵剑，只是它的主人已经不在了…

item_desc7000060.en: This is the book Yuanzhi wanted. The pages are empty, except for a small line on the cover, "What do you want, may I ask?" The book emits a very eerie aura.
item_desc7000060.ch: 愿知想要的书，除了封面上写有一行小字“君心何所求，可愿一问之？”，书页内空无一字，整本书散发着一种诡异的气息。

item_desc7000061.en: Written after the Adventure of Jun Yuanzhi

item_desc7000062.en: Written after the Adventure of Jun Yuanzhi

item_desc7000064.en: A letter... That's all you need to know for the sake of your safety...
item_desc7000064.ch: 一封信件……行走八荒，最好不要知道得太多……

item_desc7000066.en:
A transparent orb with a blurred array of light and shadow at its core. According to some legends, it could condense into an array of unprecedented power under certain circumstances.
<g>●</g>After reaching Reborn Late and finished the condensation of three Heavenly Powers, follow the guide to obtain it.
item_desc7000066.ch:
一个透明的球体，球内一个光影组成的法阵若隐若现，据说可以在特定情况下凝结出八荒中威能莫测的阵法。
<g>●</g>羽化后期凝练三枚仙力后，跟随指引获得。

item_desc7000068.en: Eat it to grow bigger in size by &710003_dlbdbl&%, and increase damage dealt by &710003_dlzsbl&% for &710003_dlcxsj&s.
item_desc7000068.ch: 食用后体型变大&710003_dlbdbl&%，造成伤害提升&710003_dlzsbl&%。持续&710003_dlcxsj&秒。

item_desc7000069.en: Eat it to gain &710003_wxsxbl&% change in size, and decrease the cooldown of all skills by &710003_wxlqbl&% for &710003_wxcxsj&s.
item_desc7000069.ch: 食用后体型&710003_wxsxbl&%，所有技能冷却&710003_wxlqbl&%。持续&710003_wxcxsj&秒。

item_desc7000070.en: Eat it to trigger 1 Chilly Wave, Freezing all enemies on the battlefield for &710003_hbdjsj&s. The time of the effect will be halved for Bosses and Cultivators.
item_desc7000070.ch: 食用后会爆发出1次寒冰波动，对全场造成冰冻，持续&710003_hbdjsj&秒。对大妖兽和修仙者持续时间减半。

item_desc7000071.en: Eat it to trigger 1 explosion throughout the battlefield, dealing &710003_lymgwl& damage to all enemies within &710003_lybzfw& range.
item_desc7000071.ch: 食用后会爆发出1次全屏爆炸，对范围&710003_lybzfw&内的所有敌方造成威力&710003_lymgwl&的伤害。

item_desc7000072.en: Eat it to trigger 1 Toxic Wave of &710003_jdbzfw& Area of Effect, dealing &710003_dsshwl& damage to all affected enemies every &710003_jdshjg&s. The Poison effect lasts for &710003_jdcxsj&s.
item_desc7000072.ch: 食用后会爆发出1次范围&710003_jdbzfw&的剧毒波动，使所有波及的敌方单位每&710003_jdshjg&秒受到威力&710003_dsshwl&的伤害，持续&710003_jdcxsj&秒。

item_desc7000073.en: Eat it to deal &710003_cjpzwl& damage to enemies collided with you, and increase your Agility by &710003_cjtsys&%. During it, you will be Invincible for &710003_cjcxsj&s.
item_desc7000073.ch: 食用后，碰撞敌人时能造成威力&710003_cjpzwl&的伤害并提升移动速度&710003_cjtsys&%，期间无敌，持续&710003_cjcxsj&秒。

item_desc7000074.en: Eat it to increase Agility by &710003_hytsys&% for &710003_hycxsj&s.
item_desc7000074.ch: 食用后，移动速度提升&710003_hytsys&%，持续&710003_hycxsj&秒。

item_desc7000075.en: A precious vial made from mellow jade. It is a rare container for Nether Air in the world; can be used to condense Nether Seed in the Cave of Nether Seeds.
item_desc7000075.ch: 用太极玉髓制作的珍贵小瓶，是八荒中极为少见的能够吸纳冥气之物，可用于在冥种幽窟中凝结冥种。

item_desc7000077.en: A mythic elixir from ancient times. Once activated, its user can become invisible against the detection of the seals inside a Sect for a short time. Use to sneak into some buildings in other person's Sect, but its user may still be detected by master cultivators. The Elixir's effect will last for only a short time once activated.
item_desc7000077.ch: 上古时期的灵丹妙药，激发后短时间内不会被宗门内的禁制探测到，可潜入他人宗门的部分建筑内。但缺点是仍有可能被修为高深之人识破。一旦激发潜入后很快就会失去效用，时间有限。

item_desc7000101.en: The tail attached with Brother Yuan Zhi' letter seems to have a little scent. I may get something if I study it.
item_desc7000101.ch: 远致兄弟随信寄来的一条“尾巴”，香泽微闻，研究一下或者另有所得？

item_desc7000102.en: The orb attached with Brother Yuan Zhi' letter just stinks, but the flickering gleam in it seems quite unusual! How about examine it?
item_desc7000102.ch: 远致兄弟随信寄来的内丹，虽然腥臭难耐，但中间一点星芒跃动闪烁，似乎并不简单！要不要研究一下？

item_desc7000103.en: There was a splotch of red and black on the sword tassels attached with Brother Yuan Zhi' letter. Something sinister!
item_desc7000103.ch: 远致兄弟随信寄来的一截剑穗，上面有一片地方呈现红黑之色，略有不祥！

item_desc7000104.en: The secret treasure You Yuanzhi found on the journey. He was unable to get it, so he wrote it down and kept it with you.
item_desc7000104.ch: 游远致旅行时发现的秘宝，他身法呆滞，无法取得，于是记录下来留与身怀道法的你。

item_desc7000105.en: Although he encountered many dangers in the journey, You Yuanzhi recorded a place in his haste that seemed to have something valuable in it.
item_desc7000105.ch: 游远致旅行时屡遇危难，匆忙之中仍然记录了一处绝境所在，中间似乎藏有好物可以一探。

item_desc7000106.en: A mysterious scroll found in a cave, it is full of unintelligible words. The Cultivator Alliance has sent members to collect these scrolls with the intention to revive the knowledge of Chi You once compiled by the early members of the Alliance.
item_desc7000106.ch: 洞府之中发现的神秘书简，里面文辞艰深，不易明白。仙盟派遣成员收集古旧残简，希望借此参透先辈们已经探明的赤幽州奥秘。

item_desc7000107.en: Indica rice teeming with Qi, it is a unique and precious treasure described in Cultivator Alliance documents as the top-level rice.
item_desc7000107.ch: 此枚玉籼飘泛灵气，乃仙盟留册记录为甲子玉籼的奇物，世不二出，珍贵非凡。

item_desc7000108.en: The Cultivator Alliance once built a large cauldron to make elixirs that would repel Nether Air. However, the cauldron exploded and the unfinished elixirs ended up as dregs. Some of them condensed into shiny solids known as Lead Residue. It is said to be able to extend one's lifespan by a hundred years, therefore reserved for those who have made great contributions to the Alliance.
item_desc7000108.ch: 昔日仙盟起大鼎炼制抵御冥气的丹药，可惜药炉中途破裂毁坏，内里灵丹尽成渣滓。而其中部分冷却后凝成晃亮固质，是为药余丹铅。据说服之可增寿百纪，为此仙盟只赠卓有功勋者。

item_desc7000109.en: A page of notes about artifact Sharp Awl.
item_desc7000109.ch: 此书页上写满大量有关法宝利锥的笔记。

item_desc7000110.en: The middle part of the awl is made from primordial iron and shining with a peculiar metal luster, while its tip is a sliver of purple Nether Air Condensation. According to the Alliance, Nether Air Condensation is divided into three quality tiers, and the condensation at the tip of the awl is of the highest tier. It can rip apart the void space with a gentle wave.
item_desc7000110.ch: 锥身中段闪耀奇特金属亮光，乃由远古异铁所制。尖端则是一截紫色的冥气结晶。仙盟记载，冥气结晶大略分为三品。利锥尖端结晶则为上品，轻轻一划，可裂虚空。

item_desc7000150.en: This parcel is from a young drunkard in the tavern. It may be more worthy of paying him some attention than to paying for his drinks.
item_desc7000150.ch: 酒馆中酒醉的青年胡言乱言之后塞来的东西，除去替他付清酒资，可能更应该去关心他一下。

item_desc7000151.en: The geography of Yong Ning, Nether Mountains, is carved on such a small woodcarving, which is really extraordinary workmanship. It must be worth a lot.
item_desc7000151.ch: 小小树雕上面篆刻冥山永宁州段的一应地理，真可谓鬼斧神工，若将此物出售只怕价值不菲。

item_desc7000152.en: The scent of this fragment seems like the Mulberry branch of East Sea. Why is the young man carrying it? Why does he try to collect Mulberry branches?
item_desc7000152.ch: 木屑上面散发这一股清香，貌似是从前东海扶桑枝的味道。青年人身上为何带有扶桑枝的碎屑？他设法收集扶桑枝又是所为何事？

item_desc7000153.en: The feather left by Three-legged Crow is bright red and still have a sense of incandescence.
item_desc7000153.ch: 三足乌遗下的羽毛，红彤彤的十分艳丽。用手轻抚，仍有炽感。

item_desc7000154.en: The same token of Cowherd and Madam Weaver, symbolizing the deep affection between you and another person. It is said that wonderful things will happen when you give it to the one you love the most.
item_desc7000154.ch: 牛郎织女的同款信物，象征着你与对方深厚的情谊。传说把它送给最心爱的人，就会发生奇妙的事情。

item_desc7000156.en: This pill is black and it also has a strange smell that I can't tell if is fragrant or smelly. Its just strange overall. But in consideration of other disciple's goodwill, do you want to take it and try it?
item_desc7000156.ch: 此枚药丸黑黝黝的，还飘散着一股不知是香还是臭的古怪味道，总体而言十分古怪。但是念及师弟一番心意，你要服下试试么？

item_desc7000158.en: A peculiar green bamboo slat with words carved on it. They seem to be someone's birthday, and there is a red stroke on it, which reminds one of a monster summoning medium. The slat is shiny green like a gem and seems very precious.
item_desc7000158.ch: 奇特的绿竹片，上面刻有文字，似是某人生辰，上面还有一道红色痕迹抹过，应是一种召妖术的媒介。竹片绿油油的，恍如碧玉，应该价值不菲。

item_desc7000159.en: Black robe and veil with strange patterns. Seem to be of the same style with those worn by the mysterious black-robed persons lately...
item_desc7000159.ch: 有奇怪纹理的黑袍与面罩，仿佛与最近神出鬼没的黑衣神秘人所穿乃是同一样式……

item_desc7000160.en: The Demons send encouraging messages to Feng Pingmo.
item_desc7000160.ch: 魔族族人为风萍末打气的书信。

item_desc7000161.en: Immortal Jo has been refining Elixirs close to the Nether Mountains recently, and they can slightly inhibit the Nether Air’s invasion of the body.
item_desc7000161.ch: 李四最近在冥山附近结庐炼制的丹药，可以稍微抑制入侵体内的冥气。

item_desc7000162.en: The Ice Flame retrieved from Everfrost is used by Immortal Jo to make a sharp weapon.
item_desc7000162.ch: 从永恒冰原神秘冰窟取得的冰硝，李四以之生成冷焰打造利器。

item_desc7000163.en: A mysterious brochure from Jo. It could be unfolded and read as a map. Key locations like Nether Seed Caverns are marked on it. According to legends, after you collected 5 Nether Seeds, you could merge them to form an Array of Gathering Nether Feathers. The critical step for making Breakthrough to the next Realm is to condense Nether Feather in this array.
item_desc7000163.ch: 李四赠予的神秘书册，展开之后乃是一幅地理图。上面标注冥种幽窟等关键地点。据说收集五枚冥种后将之融合能生成五冥凝羽阵，而于此阵凝练冥羽则是突破境界的关键。

item_desc7000164.en: Illusory Bamboo Forest, a Mystic Realm in the south of Yong Ning, is a place teeming with pure Qi. Nurtured by Qi all year long, some bamboos here have borne miraculous jades inside them, known by the cultivators as Bamboo Hearts. It is said that as a Spiritual Item, Bamboo Heart can resonate with the Nether Air buried deep underground. That's why it can be used to locate uncharted places through geomancy.
item_desc7000164.ch: 永宁州南部秘境幻虚竹海乃灵气钟毓之处。竹海中的翠竹长年受灵气滋养，部分竹子因此生出神奇碧玉。此碧玉机缘巧合下为修仙者发现记录，是为竹空木心。据说竹空木心作为灵物能够与部分深藏地底的冥气生成物品产生共鸣，故能借此堪舆探测未知之地。

item_desc7000165.en: The Qi in this valley has condensed into an agate-like stone over the long years of their struggle against the Nether Essence Cavern under Lei Ze. The lightning in this place, peculiar as it is, would often strike this stone-formed Qi and ignite the pure Energy at its core, leaving a fire in the stone. That's why it came to be known as Fire in Stone.
item_desc7000165.ch: 此谷墟中灵气为对抗雷泽地底的冥元幽窟，自动凝聚，累年成为玛瑙一样的石头。而此地紫电特具神异，一经生成劈落与石质灵气接触，即能将内里精纯灵力激活点燃，彷如石中之火，故名石火之光。

item_desc7000166.en: In the early days after world creation, the Nether Air in the cavern forced the mountains to press against each other, rending a Mystic Realm with pure Qi into a rift valley. Connected to the underground Nether Air cavern, this rift valley was influenced by both Nether Air and Qi, leaving room for the generation of a very special soil that can be kneaded into any shape. This property and the name of the Tempting Valley led the cultivator who discovered it to call it the Tempting Soil.
item_desc7000166.ch: 八荒初成之际，因为幽窟冥气的作用下导致地区群山互相挤压，将一处灵气精纯的秘境撕成裂谷。此处裂谷与地底冥气幽窟暗暗相连，清浊交互之下形成无数特殊土壤。此壤性质特异，随圆就方，能把捏成一切形状；发现此物的修仙者因其诡秘特异且独产于魅谷，故将之称为魅壤。

item_desc7000167.en: An ice angelica similar in shape to an ordinary angelica. Pure Qi on the tundra converged and condensed into water, which was frozen into frost that budded for three thousand years before forming the shape of an angelica. Its ice crystal form and light fragrance further add to its peculiarity.
item_desc7000167.ch: 形如白芷之花的冰芷花。乃由冰原精纯灵气聚成，再由灵气而成真水，又由真水凝成冰霜，最后结蕾发蕊，累三千年而成白芷外形。此宝状如冰晶，嗅之犹有幽香，十分神奇。

item_desc7000168.en: Shiny silver crystal formed by the fusion of Sun Flame and the mercury flowing from the strange rocks in Desolate Sandbar, a Mystic Realm in Wayward Desert. That's why it came to be known as Mercury Crystal.
item_desc7000168.ch: 以迷途荒漠秘境寂寞沙洲之中怪石流出的水银和以阳炎精金而成的晃亮银晶；修道之士将搬运周天汇聚灵气结成的道胎称为元婴；而此物聚流质水银而成晶石，故为汞源。

item_desc7000169.en: An ice flower found in Snowfield Ice Coffin, it would melt once you hold in your hand, unlike Ice Angelica, another Spiritual Item. Please exercise caution.
item_desc7000169.ch: 雪野冰棺之中找到的冰花，与灵物冰芷不同，六出冰花一旦把握手中随即融化，请谨慎使用。

item_desc7000170.en: Manuscripts of Nether Air study left behind by cultivator Huaixu. It has a patch of dark red stain, which seems to be dried blood.
item_desc7000170.ch: 八荒修仙者怀虚道人对冥气探究的手录稿，上面有一滩暗红色的痕迹，似是已经干涸的血迹。

item_desc7000171.en: A strange wood plaque carved with unintelligible words. It seems to be used to summon a spirit. Perhaps you can activate your Mind Sea to decipher it.
item_desc7000171.ch: 一块奇特的木牌，上面刻有不可辨识的古怪文字，似是什么召灵的佐物。其中的古怪，或者可以通过启动识海辨别此物。

item_desc7000172.en: The wood remnants are very similar to the Mulberry Branch from Divine Mulberry Guardian. It gives off a faint, unusual fragrance.
item_desc7000172.ch: 木质余屑与昔日从扶桑树守护者处求得的扶桑树枝极为相似。还隐约散发一股不易察觉的异香。

item_desc7000173.en:
You have perceived the intention of the Nether Seed in your Mind Sea and learned that you can extract special Qi from the Breath of Chaos to tame the Nether Seed. This breath contains Ancient Qi not seen in this world.
<g>●</g>After reaching Bottleneck in <g>Reborn Early</g>, try to make Breakthrough and obtain it in a Story.
item_desc7000173.ch:
你从识海中参透冥种意向，得知可以从混沌之息中提取特殊灵气使冥种驯服。此气息之中包含远古灵气，八荒之中，绝无仅有。
<g>●</g>当修行至<g>羽化初期瓶颈</g>时，尝试突破，进行事件获取。

item_desc7000174.en:
Ancient Qi extracted from Blessed Breath of Chaos. It's very different from its counterpart in this world. It seems Ancient Qi can blend easily with Nether Air...
<g>●</g>After reaching Bottleneck in <g>Reborn Middle</g>, try to make Breakthrough and obtain it in a Story.
item_desc7000174.ch:
你从上品混沌之息中提取的远古灵气。此灵气与八荒之中的灵力大不相同，一切似乎昭示着远古灵力与冥气竟能水乳交融……
<g>●</g>当修行至<g>羽化中期瓶颈</g>时，尝试突破，进行事件获取。

item_desc7000175.en: A peculiar artifact bronze mirror found in a mysterious cave, it is covered by a layer of flowing Nether Air. Gu Yuan'er believes it was hand-made by the late elder Gu Nangang.
item_desc7000175.ch: 从神秘洞府中获得的奇异法宝铜镜，上面微微有一层冥气不断散聚；经顾鸢儿鉴别，此物为已故长老顾南罡手制。

item_desc7000176.en: This is the record left by Duanmu Shenghan.
item_desc7000176.ch: 这是端木胜寒留下的记录。

item_desc7000177.en: An elixir made by Feng Lixi with a secret recipe. Once taken, it first tastes unbearably hot, but once chewed, it tastes as cold as ice water. It is said to be able to extend one's lifespan and resist all sorts of illnesses.
item_desc7000177.ch: 风里希凭借秘方炼制的丹药。此药入口炽热难耐，咀嚼之后却又如饮冰水，遍体生寒。据传服下此药，可延年益寿，百病不侵。

item_desc7000178.en: When this incense is being made, it gives off an odious smell, the first sniff of which would block one's veins, the second shatter one's lungs, and the third poison one to death. It is said that two elders died when making this incense for the Alliance. However, once it is finished and ignited, it gives off a pleasant smell that lasts for over half a year and revives the dead who catches its smell.
item_desc7000178.ch: 此香初炼之时，恶臭盈室，一嗅脉堵，再嗅肺裂，三度吸入即中毒身亡。昔日仙盟为炼此香，两位长老因此故去。据传此香但成，点燃一束，香气半年不去，而且亡者闻之，片刻还阳。

item_desc7000179.en: A food box made by Wei He himself. In addition to the snow white rice abundant in Qi, the side dishes made with all sorts of delicacies make it all the more appetizing.
item_desc7000179.ch: 卫禾亲自烹调的食盒。里面除去雪白晶莹，飘散灵气的米饭还有各式山珍制成的拌饭小菜，看着叫人垂涎欲滴。

item_desc7000180.en: It's similar to a peach or a plum, but not exactly the same. Its surface is as clear as a mirror, and it has an aura of Qi. One may as well call it a divine fruit.
item_desc7000180.ch: 似桃非桃，似李非李，表面光亮如镜，几可鉴人。而果子周围灵气缭绕，说是仙果，并不过分。

item_desc7000181.en: A charm said to be an immortal’s treasure lost in this world, its power can be used to change weather. However, the charm is also under restriction from the Law of the world, and it will disappear once its power is released. After that, it may take some time to concentrate power into another charm again. The Charm is one of the world’s most desired treasures, and every time its whereabouts are known, monsters in Lei Ze will fight for it.
item_desc7000181.ch: 据传为上界遗落的符箓。一经使用能够改变天气。但似此符同样受天地法则限制，使用之后灵力耗尽即消失不见，经过一段时间后才能重聚实体，再化符箓。此物一旦现世，便即惹来雷泽妖兽争夺，乃八荒至宝。

item_desc7000182.en: The envelope is tainted with a brownish hue. It has been kept here for a long time after finished. The writer hoped his future clansmen help him conceal the truth about Jo's past.
item_desc7000182.ch: 信封已经泛黄，可以看出写好以后已经保存很长一段时间了。信中内容大体是希望夸父族后人继续隐瞒李四身世真相。

item_desc7000183.en: The envelope is new. The writer composed the letter with simple words - he must be a candid giant from the Kuafu Clan, eager to seek reasons behind abnormalities. The writer expressed his confidence in Jo, saying he could get back on his feet.
item_desc7000183.ch: 信封较新。书写者文辞较为幼稚，可知此人定是一名性子朴实，只为追求真理的夸父族巨人。信末巨人还对李四表现出信心，觉得他能自己站起来。

item_desc7000184.en: An exquisite wooden carving. It seems to be a wooden hairpin, but a closer examination will reveal its carving of the landscape of this world on its side.
item_desc7000184.ch: 一支十分精致的木雕。端近细看，可见此物从侧面雕刻的八荒山海地理，离远粗看则似一支木簪。

item_desc7000185.en: It recorded a clip from the Sixty-Four Validations on the world's future made in ancient times by the Kuafu Clan. It seems to be talking exclusively about Jo's fate.
item_desc7000185.ch: 据说是远古之时，夸父一族预测八荒未来运势时的“重八验证”的片段，当中似乎全是关于李四个人命运的片段。

item_desc7000186.en: It recorded a clip from the Sixty-Four Validations on the world's future made in ancient times by the Kuafu Clan. It seems to be talking exclusively about Jo's fate.
item_desc7000186.ch: 据说是远古之时，夸父一族预测八荒未来运势时的“重八验证”的片段，当中似乎全是关于李四个人命运的片段。

item_desc7000187.en: A secret treasure of Jo. It is said that a master cultivator intended to disperse the Nether Air in Chi You using it, but the plan was proven infeasible due to the extreme difficulty in making the charm. The chart was then archived somewhere until it was rediscovered by Jo.
item_desc7000187.ch: 李四的秘藏。相传昔日大能打算凭借此符驱散赤幽州冥气。只因此符箓制作繁难，无法轻易产出，故藏于宝楼，不再使用。其后辗转为李四所得。

item_desc7000188.en: A rare trophy from Taotie. The horn will usually turn into ashes once Taotie is dead, and even a shard of it can grant considerable power to talismans if one grounded it with special ores to make a cinnabar-like powder. Some extraordinary talismans need to be drawn with this material.
item_desc7000188.ch: 饕餮犄角十分特异，妖兽死亡，犄角亦同时化去。若有有幸取得一星半点，并将之混以特殊矿物制成朱砂，可使符箓产生质变。据闻部分珍贵符箓需以此物为媒才能画成。

item_desc7000189.en: Phoenix revives from the most fierce flames. It is said that in the past, a master cultivator had an agreement with a phoenix, hoping to introduce its flame into the world with charms. Then, the Nether Air started to spread into the world, and the cultivator ignited True Flame with the charm to protect people from perishing.
item_desc7000189.ch: 凤为浴火之鸟。相传昔日八荒大能与九天凤鸟达成协议，以道符为媒，借其羽翼阳炎为己用。其后八荒冥气扩散，该大能凭此宝箓燃起真火，成功驱散冥气，保住一方仙民。

item_desc7000190.en: A translucent flute made of purest jade. A curious fragrance drifts around it, but amidst the pleasant scent hides a hint of blood. With a length longer than ordinary flutes and a total of thirteen holes, it is said to be a master cultivator's instrument. The legendary owner once played a tune with it to summon dragons and phoenixes, and the melody tinted the clouds a glorious crimson.
item_desc7000190.ch: 通透晶莹的白玉笛子，上面微微泛着一阵香气，但同时又存有一股微弱的血腥之味。此外，该笛长度较一般玉笛为长，且笛身洞开十三孔，不类寻常笛子。据传昔有大能，吹奏此笛，引凤来龙，九天云霞为之尽赤。

item_desc7000201.en: A carrot that lets out an aroma of elixirs. Perhaps putting it into the furnace will add a carrot flavor to all elixirs you brew!
item_desc7000201.ch: 弥漫着丹香的胡萝卜，也许炼丹之时将其投入炉中，会让整炉丹药都变成胡萝卜味的！

item_desc7000202.en: A carrot that emits heat. It seems to have been hammered thousands of times yet it refuses to be crushed.
item_desc7000202.ch: 散发着热气的胡萝卜，似乎经受了千万次锤打，虽然干瘪却仍顽强地存在着。

item_desc7000203.en: A carrot that has an aura around it. It keeps spinning on your palm as if it is alive.
item_desc7000203.ch: 散发着气场的胡萝卜，在你掌中兀自转个不停，似乎颇有灵性。

item_desc7000204.en: A carrot that lets out an aroma of herbs. It's a natural food ingredient that can improve one's health.
item_desc7000204.ch: 弥漫着药香的胡萝卜，充满了大自然的气息，天然食材，养生首选。

item_desc7000205.en: A carrot covered in dirt. Despite its appearance, it's a decent, complete carrot deep inside.
item_desc7000205.ch: 沾满着污垢的胡萝卜，虽然外表很脏，但内心仍然是一根质地完好的萝卜。

item_desc7000206.en: A carrot carved with glyphs written in an ancient, arcane language.
item_desc7000206.ch: 雕刻着纹路的胡萝卜，身上的文字似乎源自某种古老的符箓，玄奥异常。

item_desc7000300.en: You find an Ugly Taoist Fruit on the body of the Heaven-chosen. There are dark marks around it, and the area where it has been bitten has clearly rotted since. This is not an item to be trifled with, let alone something to be eaten.
item_desc7000300.ch: 从天骄尸体上搜查到的怪异道心果，表面有黑斑，被咬之处呈腐蚀状，一看就不是什么正经玩意，最好还是不要吃了。

item_desc7000301.en: You find a letter on the body. It has been crumpled, but you can still make out the writing, and it seems to have a use as a Taoist Fruit container.
item_desc7000301.ch: 从天骄尸体上搜查到的信纸，因为被压在身下已然褶皱不堪，但仍然能辨认出字迹，似乎是用来裹道心果的包装。

item_desc7000302.en: It seems like some kind of strange, forbidden orb. There is no way to focus through to it, and it seems to be what both the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple are after.
item_desc7000302.ch: 表面布满禁制的诡异光团，念力无法渗透进去分毫，似乎便是道心阁和蚀心殿争夺的目标。

item_desc7000303.en: A mysterious letter has arrived. Could this contain a shocking secret?
item_desc7000303.ch: 神秘的来信，莫非内里藏着什么惊人的秘密么？

item_desc7000304.en: A jade plaque with a sign that marks a mysterious location. It's unknown who made it and left it here...
item_desc7000304.ch: 标记着一处神秘位置的玉牌，无法确认是何人所留……

item_desc7000305.en: Records of the secret history of a master sword cultivator. They seem like the remains from a chapter in a larger work. It's not clear who compiled it, but much of it seems to be embellished.
item_desc7000305.ch: 记录着一位剑修大能曾经往事的书籍，似乎是一整套书的某个篇章残卷。不知由谁编纂而成，大概半真半假，演义成分居多。

item_desc7000306.en: Records of the secret history of a master sword cultivator. They seem like the remains from a chapter in a larger work. It's not clear who compiled it, but much of it seems to be embellished.
item_desc7000306.ch: 记录着一位剑修大能曾经往事的书籍，似乎是一整套书的某个篇章残卷。不知由谁编纂而成，大概半真半假，演义成分居多。

item_desc7000307.en: Records of the secret history of a master sword cultivator. They seem like the remains from a chapter in a larger work. It's not clear who compiled it, but much of it seems to be embellished.
item_desc7000307.ch: 记录着一位剑修大能曾经往事的书籍，似乎是一整套书的某个篇章残卷。不知由谁编纂而成，大概半真半假，演义成分居多。

item_desc7000308.en: Records of the secret history of a master sword cultivator. They seem like the remains from a chapter in a larger work. It's not clear who compiled it, but much of it seems to be embellished.
item_desc7000308.ch: 记录着一位剑修大能曾经往事的书籍，似乎是一整套书的某个篇章残卷。不知由谁编纂而成，大概半真半假，演义成分居多。

item_desc7000309.en: A sword fragment containing heavenly power. It cannot be properly used since it is only a fragment.
item_desc7000309.ch: 一把蕴含着仙力的剑的碎片。由于只是碎片，所以并不能使用。

item_desc7000310.en: Zigu's painting created according to your description. It depicts Linyuan's imagined life at the Swordsmanship Manor with Yue'er.
item_desc7000310.ch: 紫姑所画，按照你的描述所画，画中是临渊想象中和月儿在剑庄的生活。

item_desc7000311.en: A flower grown in Arctic Field.

item_desc7000312.en: A flower grown in the mountains, it is usually guarded by monsters. Chance to obtain after defeated Mythical Beasts in Hundred Thousand Hills.
item_desc7000312.ch: 生长于高山之上的花，周围常有大妖兽守护。在击败十万大山的大妖兽时，有概率获得。

item_desc7000313.en: A flower grown in Lei Ze.

item_desc7000314.en: A fortune stick indicating the current location of {0}, the Nether Demon. Made of wood from aged trees in the Nether Mountains, it can accurately locate the source of characteristic Nether Air.
item_desc7000314.ch: 记载着冥妖{0}当前位置的神奇灵签，使用之木材在冥山中生长多年，能够精准判断特殊冥气的来源方位。

item_desc7000315.en: Evidence of slaying Nether Demons. It signifies the contribution to Humans by Cultivators in the Alliance and can be used to exchange precious items in Main Manual Pavilion there.
item_desc7000315.ch: 击杀冥妖的凭证，象征着仙盟修仙者对人族立下的功绩，可以在仙盟的琅琊主阁内兑换珍贵道具

item_desc7000316.en: A barrel full of leaping and patting fish.
item_desc7000316.ch: 满满一桶鱼，还活蹦乱跳的。

item_desc7000317.en: A kind of translucent and jade-like rice nourished by the Qi of the world.
item_desc7000317.ch: 一种汲取天地灵气而成的米，晶莹剔透，洁白如玉。

item_desc7000318.en: A little note showing the place where Li Hanshan hid her treasure. Someone says it also contains secrets of other Immortals, but maybe it’s just another rumor...
item_desc7000318.ch: 记载着厉寒珊藏宝地点的纸条。据说里面藏着其他仙人的小秘密，似乎不太靠谱的样子……

item_desc7000319.en: A bead of unknown usage. You see unintelligible inscriptions in it.
item_desc7000319.ch: 不知有何用的珠子，里面刻着难以辨识的文字。

item_desc7000401.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Liangqu, it seems to be written by the masters of fishing in this world, with all species of fish and their living habits included.
item_desc7000401.ch: 梁渠所赠之物，无法使用。似乎是善于垂钓的大能之士所作，记录着八荒所有的鱼类和生活习性。

item_desc7000402.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Shuangshuang, it bears an astonishingly vivid similarity to the cat on her shoulder.
item_desc7000402.ch: 双双所赠之物，无法使用。与双双肩上的猫近乎一模一样，栩栩如生。

item_desc7000403.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Feng Linglan, it is a voluminous medicine book discussing Qi and Nether Air, filled with obscure writings and contents.
item_desc7000403.ch: 风灵兰所赠之物，无法使用。一本厚厚的研究灵气与冥气的医书，其中的文字和内容晦涩难懂。

item_desc7000404.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Dijiang, it is a piece of paper bearing his footprint. Maybe its sole usage is being collected.
item_desc7000404.ch: 帝江所赠之物，无法使用。一张印着帝江的脚印的纸，似乎除了珍藏并无其他用途。

item_desc7000405.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Yaoji, it is a blossom that will never wilt. You could smell the faint scent from it.
item_desc7000405.ch: 瑶姬所赠之物，无法使用。一朵永不凋零的花，嗅闻还有淡淡的花香。

item_desc7000406.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Su Mobai, they are a pair of Go pieces, one is black and the other white. They constantly draw near to the other, but will never collide.
item_desc7000406.ch: 苏墨白所赠之物，无法使用。一黑一白的两枚棋子相互吸引，但无论如何也无法让其相触碰。

item_desc7000407.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Li Hanshan, it is a red Fortune Stick indicating Major Blessing, maybe something good will happen.
item_desc7000407.ch: 厉寒珊所赠之物，无法使用。一枚红色的上吉灵签，似乎预示着祥瑞。

item_desc7000408.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Sun Blocking Heavenly Mushroom, it is sleeping - perhaps it won’t be awakened by anything.
item_desc7000408.ch: 蔽日仙菌所赠之物，无法使用。一颗小仙菌，但正在沉睡，似乎外界何事都无法吵醒它。

item_desc7000409.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Lizhu, it is a token with the inscription read as "Lizhu". It is made from unknown materials, perhaps it does not belong to this world.
item_desc7000409.ch: 离珠所赠之物，无法使用。刻着“离珠”二字的令牌，材质特殊似乎并非八荒之物。

item_desc7000410.en: Cannot be used. A gift from Canglong, it is a bottle with the scent of liquor. You remember Canglong’s instruction on the vessel used for drinking once you see it.
item_desc7000410.ch: 沧泷所赠之物，无法使用。一壶还泛着酒香的酒壶，似乎在告诉你喝酒得用壶。

item_desc7000411.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Lu Linxi, they are a pair of shed antlers, their surfaces are still fluffy.
item_desc7000411.ch: 鹿林溪所赠之物，无法使用。一对自然脱落的角，还有些毛茸茸的。

item_desc7000412.en: Cannot be used. A gift of King Luhua, it is a piece of a majestic feather, but maybe its sole usage is to tickle someone.
item_desc7000412.ch: 芦花王所赠之物，无法使用。一根霸气四溢的羽毛，但除了挠痒痒以外别无他用。

item_desc7000413.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Jianyi, it is a sword once wielded by him when he was a boy. There are some dents on the sword.
item_desc7000413.ch: 剑一所赠之物，无法使用。乃他儿时曾使用的剑，剑上还有着些许伤疤。

item_desc7000414.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Ji Guhun, it is a shard of Heavenly Stone, but it seems to come from somewhere other than a heavenly place.
item_desc7000414.ch: 季沽魂所赠之物，无法使用。一块仙石的碎片，虽名为仙石，但似乎并非是仙界之物。

item_desc7000415.en: Cannot be used. A gift of Mingxue, it is a brand-new flute, same as the one hanging on her belt.
item_desc7000415.ch: 茗雪所赠之物，无法使用。一支崭新的笛子，与茗雪腰间的笛子款式相同。

item_desc7000417.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Yun Mengyi into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000417.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和云梦衣，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000418.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Cangya into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000418.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和沧崖，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000419.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Jiuchen into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000419.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和酒尘，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000420.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Muqing into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000420.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和沐晴，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000421.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Li Ningshuang into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000421.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和厉凝霜，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000422.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Jiang Lingge into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000422.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和姜菱歌，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000423.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Zhu Yaoyue into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000423.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和烛遥月，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000424.en: A painting given to you by Zigu. She painted you and Leng Jingtang into it, maybe that’s what you two look like in her eyes.
item_desc7000424.ch: 紫姑所赠之画，里面画着你和冷惊棠，似乎这就是紫姑心中你们的样子。

item_desc7000501.en: The crystal condensed on the dead bodies of Nether Demons, containing the pure energy of Nether Air inside them. Use to send it directly to the Cultivator Alliance for Battle Contribution.
item_desc7000501.ch: 冥妖死亡后，其尸体上凝结而出的血色晶体，蕴藏着冥妖体内纯粹的冥气能量，使用后可自动将其传送至仙盟处换取战功。

item_desc7000600.en: The Elixir Recipes recorded in it are unknown to you. In addition, some notes in the collection tell you that a grand event of a mysterious organization will open soon.
item_desc7000600.ch: 丹方之中记录之丹方从未所见，而辑录之中还留有若干文字，似乎记录某神秘组织的盛会即将开启。

item_desc7000601.en: An invitation letter sent by Yao Chenzun's subordinate, written with white, herb-scented paper. You also find a map indicating the location of the Temple behind it.
item_desc7000601.ch: 药辰尊派遣手下送来的请帖，信纸白净精致，药香微闻。笺后更附地图表明神鼎观详细位置。

item_desc7000602.en: The map marks out the location of the Divine Cauldron Temple's branch with notes and symbols.
item_desc7000602.ch: 地理图中分别以文字与图画记载神鼎观分舵遗址地理。

item_desc7000603.en: These are the records of events in the Divine Cauldron Temple, written by predecessor alchemists.
item_desc7000603.ch: 神鼎观先辈于册中记录了神鼎观的大事。

item_desc7000604.en: It is a record of daily life from an unknown cultivator. There are some cultivation knacks in it, but other contents are all evil plots and schemes experienced by the author.
item_desc7000604.ch: 一本修仙者的日常记事，当中记录了这名修仙者一些修炼心得，其余都是他所经历勾心斗角之恶事。

item_desc7000700.en: A soul fragment lost in the Fallen Valley. All its senses are gone, leaving only the spirit power. It is said that the fragment can be used to amend some broken souls for a short time of incarnation.
item_desc7000700.ch: 留存于陨幽谷中的远古残灵，一切知觉意识已然泯灭，仅余魂力。据道籍所载，此灵能够契合某些特殊灵魂，使之修补完整，暂存人形。

item_desc7000701.en: A mystical herb grown in Everfrost. It resembles snow, but is always warm; someone said that it will melt even the thickest ice. The herb can be found only in the remotest corner of Everfrost and is popular with the monsters there.
item_desc7000701.ch: 生长于永恒冰原的神奇草本植物，状如白雪，却通体炽热；此物长于极为荒僻之处，为冰原妖物喜爱携带。传说此物能消极寒玄冰，十分神妙。

item_desc7000702.en: A precious stone that can transfer souls into artifacts. Master cultivators in ancient times tried to infuse their artifacts with the souls found in the Fallen Valley using the stone as a medium. It was soon sought after since then.
item_desc7000702.ch: 据传此物能转移魂灵至器物之上。远古大能曾借此物试验转化陨幽谷灵魂至法宝之上，成为器灵，乃不世之珍宝。

item_desc7000703.en: An elixir carefully prepared by Sanguira, with a delightful herbal scent. According to Sanguira, the elixir will boost the physique of its user and grant those who took it longevity.
item_desc7000703.ch: 血微精心炼制的丹药，开盒之后，一股药香扑鼻而来。据血微所说，此物能延寿命，强健体魄，十分珍贵。

item_desc7000704.en: A letter from Jiang Lanyan. It was composed with graceful handwriting, but its last paragraphs were finished in haste. Maybe she met urgent matters at that time.
item_desc7000704.ch: 江岚燕留给你的信件。书信前半段字迹娟秀，后半段则略见仓促，估计写信之人当时一定遇到什么急事了吧？

item_desc7000705.en: A letter from Sanguira. It seems that Sanguira has already dispelled the depression from her failed plan and decided to continue her journey for a remedy to the fleeting lives of her people and herself.
item_desc7000705.ch: 血微留给玩家的信件。从书信内容看，血微已走出阴霾，并坚定了继续寻找延长自己族人及自己寿命的决心。

item_desc7000706.en: A letter from Xi. It was written in a joyful tone. Maybe she has recovered from Yu's passing.
item_desc7000706.ch: 阿嬉的书信，行文颇见欢愉之情，阿嬉应该已经走出阿禹离世的阴霾了。

item_desc7000707.en: There is a title on the top of each page. It reads, "Travel Diary in (illegible) - Record on the Course of Earth Veins There, Amended Version". Its content is a seemingly comprehensive document on earth veins and their properties, but the pages are wet and the writings are largely unreadable.
item_desc7000707.ch: 这些记录文字的纸张顶端写着“某某行纪增补·地脉潜行实录”某某二字已辨认不清。文字内容似乎详实地记载了有关地脉的各种特性，不过书页因为被水打湿，大多文字已辨别不清。

item_desc7000708.en: A map recording the route to the Supreme Anvil, with plenty of notes guiding its readers through the dangers along the way. It must be compiled with unimaginable effort.
item_desc7000708.ch: 记录大冶台确切所在的地图。其中有许多标注详细写明了每一个险地应该如何通过。绘制这张地图应该倾注了制作者大量心血。

item_desc7011012.en: An abundance of gold can be found on the southern hill facing the sun on Mt. Qi, while the northern hill is plentiful in jade and mystic gems! One of such gems radiates a refreshing chill when held and is helpful for maintaining a clear mind. It has thus earned the name "Heaven's Yin".
item_desc7011012.ch: 在岐山向阳的南坡上，蕴藏着大量的黄金，而背阴的北坡上，则布遍了各式各样的美玉与奇石。这其中有一种宝石，持在手中便能感受其中散发出的丝丝凉意，可使人保持神志清醒，故称其为天阴。

item_desc7011013.en: This rare item holds the powers of both yin and yang and is therefore known as the "stone of duality". Wear it to be immune from all diseases.
item_desc7011013.ch: 其中蕴含着一阴一阳之力，故此被人称为双仪，乃天地间罕见的奇石！据说此物还可使佩戴者免受疾病之灾。

item_desc7011014.en: Legends have it that when the pillar of the heavens crumbled and the skies collapsed, Nüwa smelted these stones on Mt. Tiantai to rebuild the heavens.
item_desc7011014.ch: 相传，在擎天大柱折断，天地崩塌之际，娲皇在天台山上炼化的便是这种石头。

item_desc7011015.en: Humans pray to the heavens, earth, the sun, the moon, wind, rain, mountains, rivers, and their ancestors. They not only perform such rituals themselves but may also hire shamans to act as a messenger between humans and gods, heavens and earth. These mysterious beings can communicate with those from above.
item_desc7011015.ch: 人们祭祀的对象包括天、地、日、月、风、雨、山川、祖先等神灵，如此繁杂的祭祀典礼除了自己举行外，还会请巫代而进行。传说巫能沟通人神、往返天地，拥有通天的修为，非常神秘。

item_desc7011025.en: These stone drums come with narrow tops, thick bottoms and a round tip. It's hard to tell what material they're made of. A "stone drum inscription" can be found carved on each of these items, detailing profound principles of the heavens and earth.
item_desc7011025.ch: 石鼓先天而成，形像鼓而上细下粗顶微圆，材质不明每个石鼓上面都镌刻 “石鼓文”，蕴含天地至理。

item_desc7021012.en: Carved jade of the highest quality from the frigid pond in Mt. Gui. Emits a hauntingly cold aura.
item_desc7021012.ch: 以騩山的万年寒潭中的美玉雕琢而成，玉中散发着冰寒彻骨的气息。

item_desc7021013.en: Jadeware rumored to be used in the rituals of Bear Mountain. Said to hold the blessings of the mountain gods and the power to extend one's life span.
item_desc7021013.ch: 传说中用于祭祀熊山的玉器，玉中带有山神的祝福，有着延年益寿之效。

item_desc7021014.en: Sculpted from quality jade from Mt. Fengyu. Quite valuable.
item_desc7021014.ch: 以风雨山中出产的美玉所雕琢而成，在八荒世界中有着较高的价值。

item_desc7021015.en: Mt. Shouyang, also known as Mt. Leishou, is rich in minerals and jades instead of flora and fauna. This legendary item is in fact carved from jade found on Mt. Shouyang.
item_desc7021015.ch: 首阳山又称雷首山，山中没有生长花草树木，却蕴含着丰富的矿物与精美的玉石！赤灵便是首阳山中的玉石雕琢而成的名品。

item_desc7021016.en: Those who worship dragons all, to some degree, revere snakes as well. Judging from the serpent pattern on this figure's clothing, he is likely one of a highly status.
item_desc7021016.ch: 崇奉着神龙的人，似乎对蛇也有着某种敬畏。此像所雕刻的人物的服饰中布满了蛇纹，他可能是一个拥有较高的身份和地位的人。

item_desc7021026.en: On this jade vessel, an ethereal, robust figure of a dragon gliding through the clouds is carved. Its airy, graceful form is truly one of an immortal.
item_desc7021026.ch: 这件玉器中所雕刻的即是苍劲飘逸的神龙，游走于缭绕翻腾的云海中，轻灵飘洒的姿态透露出一股仙家之气。

item_desc7021036.en: This slightly-chipped jade hoop comes with entwining dragon patterns. It's cool to the touch and beautifully lucent.
item_desc7021036.ch: 以寒玉精炼而成，环形有缺，龙纹盘附，晶莹剔透，冰寒彻骨。

item_desc7031012.en: Made of maple wood, this lovely guqin is covered with patterns of flying fish. It produces notes that sound as sweet and soothing as the wind.
item_desc7031012.ch: 由枫木所制，琴身上雕刻着许多文鳐鱼。奏响之音犹如清风拂过，可平静人的内心。

item_desc7031013.en: The arch of this instrument is carved from the best jade found on Mt. Yiwang. It's capable of producing hundreds of different sounds and can also repel evil auras.
item_desc7031013.ch: 琴柱是以翼望山中所取的上好玉石雕琢而成！此琴能奏出数百种不同的声音，还可避除凶邪之气。

item_desc7031014.en: An instrument made using white deer hair, which is quite rare—it takes a deer a thousand years to develop a pale pelt, and another five hundred for the fur to turn white.
item_desc7031014.ch: 以白鹿之毛发为弦所制的琴。据说普通的鹿生长千年毛皮便会变成苍色，再生长五百年后才会变为白色，足见白鹿之珍贵！

item_desc7031015.en: The strings of this guqin is made of mystic silk and produces sounds as pleasant as that of jade stones clinking together.
item_desc7031015.ch: 此琴以天玄丝为弦而制，琴动之声玉石碰撞般悦耳，十分动听！

item_desc7031016.en: The face of this guqin is made out of parasol wood and its bottom out of cedar. It's painted all over in purple and covered in a snake-belly pattern. The grey color of deer antlers peeks out from under the pattern, and underneath it is coarse grass fabric.
item_desc7031016.ch: 琴以梧桐作面，杉木为底，通体髹紫漆，多处跦漆修补，发小蛇腹断纹，纯鹿角灰胎显现于磨平之断纹处，鹿角灰胎下用葛布为底。

item_desc7031026.en: In the center of the world stands Mt. Tian Yuan, on which peak is a stone platform, where a guqin is placed. For thousands of years, no one has been able to play it. All people know about it is its name: "Music of the Ancients".
item_desc7031026.ch: 八荒正中有一山曰天元，峰巅之上有一石台上置一琴，数千年来无人可拨动琴弦，无人知其玄妙，只有其名流传于世，“太古遗音”。

item_desc7041012.en: Sandalwood and paper mulberries are abundant on Mt. Lai. These trees are the favorite perch of countless Roro Birds, which are insanely fierce man-eating creatures.Their feathers are often used for decoration, for example on the Ferro flute.
item_desc7041012.ch: 莱山中有许许多多的檀香树和构树，而这些树中活跃着无数的罗罗鸟。罗罗鸟异常凶猛，可食人！其羽常常被匠人用于装饰物品，飞罗笛便是其一。

item_desc7041013.en: A jade flute covered with intricate patterns of flying fish. Rumored to be capable of warding off disasters involving weapons and conflict.
item_desc7041013.ch: 以玉石所制的笛，笛身上细刻了许许多多的飞鱼，据说可避免兵刃之灾。

item_desc7041014.en: Legend has it that a hunter once climbed a strange mountain by accident and encountered a beast resembling a monkey that's striped all over. It's said that the hunter made this flute using the beast's bones.
item_desc7041014.ch: 传闻中有一猎户在偶然之间闯入了一座奇山，他在山中遇到到了一种形似猕猴，全身都带有斑纹的野兽。据说此笛就是用那猎户所带回的兽骨所制的。

item_desc7041015.en: A translucent flute that is cool to the touch. Produces a soothing melody.
item_desc7041015.ch: 笛身晶莹剔透，散发着阵阵凉气，奏响之音可安抚心神。

item_desc7041016.en: A quaint flute that produces music that captivates the soul of those who hear it.
item_desc7041016.ch: 材质古朴的笛子，奏响的魔音可夺魂摄魄。

item_desc7051012.en: There's said to be a grassless mountain abundant in jades of all kinds. On the mountain lives the Bi Fang, a bird shaped like a crane, but with blue feathers and a white beak. It's known as the symbol of longevity, and its feathers are therefore used in manufacturing all sorts of items.
item_desc7051012.ch: 传说中有一座寸草不生，却布遍着各种美玉的山。山中有一种禽鸟，其形似仙鹤，有着青色的羽毛与白色的嘴巴，被人视为长寿的象征。于是，便有人用毕方的羽毛制作各种各样的物品。

item_desc7051013.en: An instrument that's absorbed the powers of the sun. Wear it to gain energy and good health. The high notes it produces may shatter all evil.
item_desc7051013.ch: 凝聚了天地间的阳之力所制的乐器。能使所佩之人精神饱满，身体健康。奏响之时，高昂之音可震慑一切邪物。

item_desc7051014.en: On Mt. Yufa is a monster called Chao that's half-bird, half-fish. Though resembling a carp, it's got chicken feet. Its flesh, when eaten, can cure tumors. Its bones can be used to play ethereal music.
item_desc7051014.ch: 在狱法山中，生长着一种半鱼半鸟的怪物，其形像鲤鱼却又长着鸡爪子，名为䲃鱼。食用了䲃鱼的肉可治愈赘瘤，其骨所制的乐器也能奏出动听的仙音。

item_desc7051015.en: Legend has it that on Mt. Guang where Jimeng lives, there's a crystalline jade well beloved by Jimeng. It can be used to forge an exquisite instrument that plays glorious music.
item_desc7051015.ch: 传说在计蒙居住的光山中，有一种晶莹剔透的美玉，深受计蒙的喜爱。用此玉所制成的乐器不但精致美观，也能奏出动听的声音。

item_desc7051016.en: Whenever the bamboo flute sounds, a refreshing breeze arrives, the colorful evening clouds meet, swans glide in the skies in pairs, peacocks flock to the edges of the forests, and all birds sing together for hours before scattering.
item_desc7051016.ch: 萧声至，清风来，奏响之时彩云四合，白鹤成对翔舞空中，孔雀数双栖集林际，百鸟合鸣经时方散。

item_desc7061012.en: Legend has it that these "musical stones" are often found in the Luo River. When clanging together, they produce a loud sound. They can be used to forge an instrument capable of warding off all evil. It's not only expensive but also represents status and power.
item_desc7061012.ch: 传说在洛水中盛产鸣石，撞击后能发出巨大的声音。奏响由鸣石所制的乐器时，能够震慑一切邪物！此物不仅是造价较高的乐器，也是地位与权力的象征。

item_desc7061013.en: An red copper instrument that's widely used in all rituals.
item_desc7061013.ch: 由赤铜矿所制的乐器，在各种仪典中广泛使用的乐器。

item_desc7061014.en: It's said that humans could summon ghosts by playing a Daphne bell in certain rituals. The Daphne bell is therefore also known as the spirit-gatherer bell.
item_desc7061014.ch: 传说在一些仪式中，人可以通过奏响槐芫可招来鬼魂，因此槐芫也被称为聚阴钟。

item_desc7061015.en: A quaintly-made instrument. Only a rare few craftsmen are skilled enough to forge such an item.
item_desc7061015.ch: 工艺古朴的乐器，即便是在八荒大陆中，能够做出此类乐器的匠人也是少之又少。

item_desc7071012.en: Back in ancient times, the ancestors worshiped the dragon totem and would pray to it for rain.
item_desc7071012.ch: 在远古时期，先民对龙的图腾十分崇拜，将龙当作了神的意象以祈求雨水。

item_desc7071022.en: According to legends, the sun is a manifestation of a divine bird. It rises in the east and sinks in the west, bringing warmth to the world. This accessory symbolizes the humans' worshiping of the divine bird as the sun god.
item_desc7071022.ch: 相传，太阳是由神鸟所化，每日东升西沉的温暖着整个世界。这件饰品便是象征着人们将神鸟视作太阳神一般崇拜着。

item_desc7071023.en: Legend has it that the Yellow Emperor once held a meeting for monsters and gods on Mt. Xitai. Chiyou attended, leading a horde of tigers, wolves, flying phoenixes and crawling snakes. It was a truly somber and impressive procession.
item_desc7071023.ch: 传说黄帝在西泰山召开“鬼神大会”，蚩尤带领着一群虎狼在前面开路，更有凤凰飞舞在空中，腾蛇伏窜在地上，整个队伍盛大而庄严。

item_desc7071033.en: Legend has it that Xingtian got his head cut off while dueling the Yellow Emperor, yet his body continued to fight on. This statue is made to commemorate his perseverance even in death.
item_desc7071033.ch: 传说刑天在与黄帝的战斗中被斩下了头颅，但其身躯依旧在不屈不挠的战斗着。人们为了歌颂他宁死不屈的精神而制作了这一尊雕像。

item_desc7071034.en: Camels are a beast often found on Mt. Yao. They have great endurance as they store water and nutrition in their humps and can in fact go dozens of days without eating or drinking.
item_desc7071034.ch: 虢山中的野兽以骆驼居多，因背上的肉峰可以贮存水分和养料，可数十天不饮不食，具有极佳的耐力。

item_desc7071044.en: In legends, there's a huge Leaning Mulberry, with its bottom half under the water and its branches above. This bronze statue is sculpted according to what the artist imagines the tree to look like.
item_desc7071044.ch: 传说中有一棵十分巨大的扶桑树，它的下半截在水下，树枝则伸出水面上。人们根据自己的想象，制作了这一尊青铜树雕像。

item_desc7071045.en: The dragon is a symbol worshiped by many, and all living beings related to the dragon are considered godly in a way. Vessels shaped like a dragon or with dragon patterns, too, are often seen as grand and dignified.
item_desc7071045.ch: 龙是人们非常崇拜的图腾，但凡是与龙沾边的生灵，皆被赋予某种神性。而龙形或具有龙纹的器物，也就显得更加的尊贵。

item_desc7071055.en: Humans love to make wine vessels in the shape of animals. Especially auspicious ones thought to repel bad luck.
item_desc7071055.ch: 人们总是喜欢将酒尊做成动物的形状，特别是一些被认为可辟邪的祥瑞之兽。

item_desc7071056.en: The vermillion bird is a legendary bird and the god of the south, revered by humans the same way they worship phoenixes. This cup, depicting a vermillion bird with a ring in its beak, is not only intricately done but also highly auspicious.
item_desc7071056.ch: 朱雀是传说中的神鸟、南方之神，被人们当作同凤凰一类的神鸟加以崇拜。这件朱雀衔环杯不仅造型精美，更是一件吉祥之物。

item_desc7071066.en: Some believe that divine powers are what brings luck on the battlefield, and carving various patterns on weapons will therefore grant them better powers as well as victory.
item_desc7071066.ch: 有些人认为胜利取决于神性的力量，于是便在兵器上雕刻着种种纹路，将会使神更多的赐予他们力量，赐予他们战争的胜利。

item_desc7071076.en: The powers of the heavens and earth are feared by many. Humans, therefore, would pray towards gods of all types and bring tributes to them in hopes of being granted peace and prosperity.
item_desc7071076.ch: 强大的天地之力总是会让人产生敬畏，于是人们便开始向各路神灵加以祭祀，祈求能借献祭来换取平安。

item_desc7081012.en: Humans believe that if they carve certain special patterns on vessels, the vessels become blessed by the gods.
item_desc7081012.ch: 人们认为将一些特殊的纹路刻画在器皿之上，便可以使得器皿被赋予某种祝福。

item_desc7081013.en: There's a species of fox with four paws and nine tails that lives on the Green Hills. They're known as "Ninetails", Sanshou, or Wangshou.
item_desc7081013.ch: 在青丘内栖息着一种狐狸，长着四只爪子九条尾巴，人们将其称为九尾狐。九尾狐这种神兽，有人叫它三寿，也有人叫它王寿。

item_desc7081014.en: Fishing is an important industry for humans. This dual-handled vessel with a small opening has fish patterns on its surface, a tribute from humans to their food source.
item_desc7081014.ch: 捕鱼是人们重要的生产方式之一。这只小口双耳瓶的腹部绘有形象化的鱼纹，表现出了人们对食物来源的重视。

item_desc7081015.en: In legends, the mountain god usually has a human body and a dragon's head. Mortals come up with all sorts of rituals to pray to him. The dance depicted on this vessel is one of those rituals.
item_desc7081015.ch: 传说中山神都是人身龙头的模样，人们为了祭祀他们，想出了各种各样的仪式，此壶中所刻画的舞蹈便是其中之一。

item_desc7081016.en: Made with fine red clay, this vessel has a wide, curled opening adorned with strips of black ribbon and two inked, matching human-faced-fish patterns on the inside.
item_desc7081016.ch: 由细泥红陶制成，敞口卷唇，口沿处绘间断黑彩带，内壁以黑彩绘出两组对称人面鱼纹。

item_desc7081026.en: This clay falcon tripod is styled like a standing male falcon, with the vessel's opening set between its wings. A truly brilliant blend of the tripod's sleek form and the falcon's striking shape.
item_desc7081026.ch: 陶鹰鼎采用伫足站立的雄鹰造型，鼎口设置于背部与两翼之间，将鼎形器物特征与鹰的动物美感巧妙地融为一体。

item_desc7091012.en: Since ancient times, our ancestors have noticed certain rules and patterns reoccurring in the natural world, for example the paths of the sun and moon, the changing of seasons and the flourishing and dying of plants. Based on such principles, Fuxi learned that the heavens and earth, day and night, men and women are parallel existences and gained insight to the concept of yin and yang, thus creating the trigrams.
item_desc7091012.ch: 在远古时期，先民在劳动过程中，逐渐发现了一些自然界的变化规律，如日月运行、四季变化、草木荣衰等。在此基础上，伏羲意识到天和地，白天和黑夜，男人和女人等都是相对应的存在，于是悟出了阴阳概念，并按四面八方排列创造了八卦。

item_desc7091022.en: Xingtian lost his head while dueling the Yellow Emperor, but he didn't die nor surrender. Using his torso as face, nipples as eyes, belly button as mouth, he held steadfastly onto his shield and axe and continued to fight. The "shield and axe" dance was choreographed based on such an image in an celebration of Xingtian's perseverance.
item_desc7091022.ch: 刑天在与黄帝的决战中被斩下了头颅，但他并没有死去，也没有屈服，他以身为脸，乳为目，脐为口，一手持盾，一手持斧，欲与黄帝再决胜负。他这一形象衍生出了一种“干戚”的舞蹈，模仿刑天不屈不挠的战神精神。

item_desc7091023.en: The Wuxian Kingdom is a nation of wizards. All inhabitants hold a green serpent in the left and a red serpent in the right, a truly intimidating sight. There's a Mt. Dengbao in Wuxian, considered a channel between the heavens and earth. The wizards often ascend to the top to speak to the gods about the wishes of the humans, and bring the gods' decrees back to the humans.
item_desc7091023.ch: 巫咸国是一个由巫师组成的国家，所有的人右手握着一条青蛇，左手握着一条红蛇，样貌十分诡异。巫咸国境内有座登葆山，是巫师来往于天上与人间的通道，他们到天上把人民的请求传达给天帝，随后又从那里下来向人民转达天帝的旨意。

item_desc7091033.en: Legends have it that the people of the Shenmu Kingdom have only one eye, embedded deep in the socket. They walk around with one hand in the air, as if waving at passers-by.
item_desc7091033.ch: 传说中，深目国之人脸上只有一只眼，深深的陷在眼眶中，平时总是举起一只手，就像是在与人打招呼的样子。

item_desc7091034.en: When the Yellow Emperor was holding the celebratory banquet after defeating Chiyou, a goddess came gliding down from the heavens. She called herself the silkworm goddess, bearing quality silk as tribute. The Yellow Emperor asked her to teach the women of the nation to weave textiles, and his wife, Leizu, started raising silkworms herself while also promoting the industry among the people.
item_desc7091034.ch: 黄帝打败了蚩尤，大摆庆功宴之时，天上突然飘然降下一位女神。这位女神自称是蚕神，特地赶来将精美的蚕丝献给黄帝，作为庆功宴上的贺礼。黄帝后来便让蚕神教导妇女缫丝纺绸，黄帝的妻子嫘祖也亲自培育幼蚕，并在百姓中推广。

item_desc7091044.en: Legends have it that some mystic spirits called Mei lives in the mountain bogs. They're shaped like humans, but with their heads lolling back, long hair an absolute mess. Their eyes and eyebrows are vertical.
item_desc7091044.ch: 传说在山泽之中有一种鬼魅，人们将其称为“祙”。祙这种怪物身形似人，脑袋拉耷在后边，披散着头发，脸上的眼睛和眉毛都是竖着生长的。

item_desc7091045.en: Before humans learned to farm, they had the innate ability to hunt. Though they tended to work together in groups, they were still weak compared to other forces of nature. This picture depicts the reverence and fear humans have for nature.
item_desc7091045.ch: 在农耕之前，人类与生俱来的本领便是在大自然中猎取食物。虽然人们采取了集体围猎的方式，但人的力量依旧显得很薄弱。此图表现出了人们对大自然的崇拜与敬畏之心。

item_desc7091055.en: In legends, there was a cardinal that flew past the Yan Emperor's head with nine wheat stalks in its beak. Some of them landed in front of the Yan Emperor, who picked them up and planted them in a field in a suitable season. Once the wheat was ripe, he distributed them to the people and taught them to farm. That was how agriculture came to be for humans, who no longer survived off the blood and flesh of animals. The Yan Emperor, from then on, was known as the "Legendary Farmer".
item_desc7091055.ch: 传说有一丹雀衔九穗飞过炎帝头顶，正好有几个稻谷掉落在炎帝面前，炎帝将其拾起，在合适的季节种于田中，等禾苗成熟后又将其分给百姓，并教会了他们耕种之法。从此，人间有了农耕，告别了茹毛饮血的时代，于是人们将炎帝称为“神农”。

item_desc7091065.en: The legendary bird, phoenix, is a symbol of great virtues and peace in the world. As it is also beautiful, many consider it a positive metaphor for women and is therefore a common motif in women's clothing and accessories.
item_desc7091065.ch: 神鸟凤凰，代表了高尚的德行，乃天下太平的祥瑞之兆。同时，它美丽的姿态又是对女子美好的祝福与比喻，常常出现在女子的衣物与饰品当中。

item_desc7091066.en: Some believe that the mountain beast depicted is a monster that lives in the mountains, while some believe it's a maiden priestess. If it weren't for the plants growing all over her body and the accompanying mountain creatures, she could very well be mistaken for a noble lady.
item_desc7091066.ch: 有的人认为图中的山鬼是山中的鬼怪，而有的人则认为山鬼是巫山神女。若不是身上披着植被，身旁有野兽相伴，几乎会被误认为是一位大家闺秀。

item_desc7091076.en: According to legends, Cangjie once climbed Mt. Yangxu and walked the shores of the Xuanhu and Luo Rivers. The mystic turtle in the river gifted him with a divine book, which content Cangjie used to create characters in the Chinese language.
item_desc7091076.ch: 传说中仓颉曾登临阳虚山，并在玄扈水、洛水之畔漫步，河中的灵龟便将内有丹甲青文的天书传授给了他，仓颉便以此为基础，创造了文字。

item_desc7091086.en: Mt. Guang is surrounded by cerulean waters, while the mountain itself is abundant in translucent jades. The god Jimeng, with a human form and a dragon's head, lives in these mountains. He'd often swim about in the depths of the Zhang waters, bringing storms wherever he goes.
item_desc7091086.ch: 光山下绿水环绕，而山中则布遍着晶莹剔透的美玉。天神计蒙便居住在这座山中，其形貌为人身龙头。他常在漳水的深渊中畅游，所到之处必定伴随着狂风暴雨。

item_desc7101012.en: Made from the bone of fowl, this item can be used to imitate the call of monsters, thus attracting other monsters, making it easy to kill them.
item_desc7101012.ch: 用禽类的骨管所制的，可以模拟妖兽的鸣叫将其吸引，从而伺机猎杀。

item_desc7101013.en: There's a monster living on Mt. Guanti named Nafu, looking much like your common ox, but with a white tail. Its whines are like a human's loud cries. Grind its horns into powder and swallow it to cure throat aches.
item_desc7101013.ch: 灌题山中栖息着一种野兽，其名为那父。它形状像普通的牛，但身后却拖着一条白色的尾巴，它发出的声音就犹如人在高声呼唤。他的角在入药后，能够缓解咽喉疼痛。

item_desc7101014.en: Turtles are extremely long-lived, and the patterns on their shells also hold endless mysteries, which is why humans often use them for divination. It's said that you may hear the voices of the heavens if you bake a turtle shell.
item_desc7101014.ch: 龟的寿命极长，它的坚甲上的纹路也充满了无穷无尽的奥妙。人们常用龟甲进行占卜，在使用烈火灼烤龟甲时，似乎能够听到传说中的天道之音。

item_desc7101015.en: Made by stringing the teeth of several mystic beasts together. Wear it to live a long life.
item_desc7101015.ch: 以多枚异兽之牙穿成，有延年益寿之效。

item_desc7101016.en: A drumstick forged from the bone of a kui and a drum made with the kui's skin. Play this drum and the world will hear.
item_desc7101016.ch: 以夔之骨精炼而成的鼓槌，再以夔之皮制成鼓。鼓槌槌鼓，音达万里，声震四方。

item_desc8103101.en: This is an ordinary visiting letter.
item_desc8103101.ch: 这是一份寻常可见的拜帖。

item_desc8103102.en: A Huayu Elixir refined by the Ugly Sage. Use it to increase Vitality by 1 permanently.
item_desc8103102.ch: 经由丑道人改良过化瘀丹，服用一颗可永久提升体力1。

item_desc8103103.en: A Nutrition Elixir refined by the Ugly Sage. Use it to increase Energy by 1 permanently.
item_desc8103103.ch: 经由丑道人改良过培元丹，服用一颗可永久提升灵力1。

item_desc8103104.en: A special elixir developed by the Ugly Sage. Use it to gain 1000 EXP.
item_desc8103104.ch: 由丑道人开发的特殊丹药，服用一颗提升1000点修为。

item_desc8103201.en: A map from a mysterious lady. You noticed a place marked with a red dot on it.
item_desc8103201.ch: 不明身份女子的地理图，上面用红点标注了一个地点。

item_desc8103202.en: It looks like a pass inside some secret orders. There is a carved character, "Tao", on it.
item_desc8103202.ch: 看起来像是某组织内部的通行令牌，上面篆刻一个道字。

item_desc8103203.en: A cup of chilly and refreshing tea steeped after three times of steaming and distilling. Its brewer made these aromatic, faint green drops with much effort.
item_desc8103203.ch: 汤呈浅碧之色，清香四溢，而入口冰凉。这是经过三蒸三馏而萃取的冰茶，倾注了制作者无数心血。

item_desc8103207.en: A notebook recording the thoughts of the cultivator. Its words are full of sadness, doubts, struggles, and conflicts.
item_desc8103207.ch: 里面记载了该名修仙者的心路历程，有伤心、有疑虑、有挣扎，充斥着各种矛盾。

item_desc8103208.en: A notebook recording the thoughts of the cultivator. Its words are full of sadness, doubts, struggles, and conflicts.
item_desc8103208.ch: 里面记载了该名修仙者的心路历程，有伤心、有疑虑、有挣扎，充斥着各种矛盾。

item_desc8103211.en: The Zouyu is a rarely-spotted legendary beast. It resembles a tiger, but with white fur and black patterns and a tail longer than its body. It does not prey on living creatures and can walk over a thousand kilometers a day, making it an excellent mount.
item_desc8103211.ch: 驺吾是八荒世界传说中的仁兽。一种十分珍贵的神兽，个体如老虎一般，身上有五彩斑斓的花纹，尾巴比身子要长，像白毛黑纹的虎，但不吃活的禽兽，很能走，骑上能日行千里。

item_desc8103221.en: The Tenghuang is a mystic beast. "The Nation of the White People is located to the north of where the Longyu can be found. The people there are white-skinned and long-haired. In the kingdom there's a beast called Tenghuang, which resembles a fox but with a horn on its back. Those who ride it shall live to two thousand years old." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_desc8103221.ch: 乘黄是八荒世界传说中的异兽。《山海经·海外西经》：“白民之国在龙鱼北，白身披发。有乘黄，其状如狐，其背上有角，乘之寿二千岁。 ”

item_desc8103231.en: "To its north is the home of the Longyu. This fish resembles the common carp, though some say it's larger, with long whiskers." —Classic of Regions Beyond the Seas: West
item_desc8103231.ch: 《山海经·海外西经》：“龙鱼陵居在其北，状如貍。一曰鰕。”

item_desc8103241.en: A sword forged with common iron. It's not a satisfactory weapon due to its poor material, so cultivators use it as a mount.
item_desc8103241.ch: 凡铁铸造而成，因材料极差，无法用于战斗，遂被制成代步之物。

item_desc8103251.en: A heavy sword forged with dark iron. It's rather wide and unsuited for combat, but it can be made a good mount.
item_desc8103251.ch: 玄铁铸造的重剑，剑身宽大，不宜用以战斗，常制成代步坐骑。

item_desc8103261.en: A long, slender weapon that is sharp in the head, made from beaten dark iron. In its rear is a short hilt and blades on both sides.
item_desc8103261.ch: 由玄铁千锤百炼锻造而成，长条形，前端尖，后端安有短柄，两边有刃。

item_desc8103271.en: The sword has been a revered item since ancient times, highly valued by both humans and gods. It is the ancestor of all melee weapons and requires unparalleled skill.
item_desc8103271.ch: 剑，古之圣品也，至尊至贵，人神咸崇。乃短兵之祖，近搏之器，以道艺精深，遂入玄传奇。

item_desc8103281.en: Zhanlu is a sword with spiritual capabilities. Despising its morally depraved owner, Helu, it traveled to the Chu Kingdom instead.
item_desc8103281.ch: 湛卢之剑恶阖闾之无也，乃去而出，水行如楚。

item_desc8103291.en: A sword is a weapon used in dire straits. It is also a weapon to be kept close and concealed in your arms.
item_desc8103291.ch: 剑，检也，所以防检非常也；又敛也，以其在身拱时敛在臂内也。

item_desc8103301.en: "In the nation of Quanfeng, there is a grand horse named Jiliang, with a snowy white body, a crimson mane and golden eyes. Those who ride it shall live to one thousand years old." —Classic of Regions Within the Seas: North
item_desc8103301.ch: 《山海经·海内北经》：（犬封国）有文马，缟身朱鬣，目若黄金，名曰吉量，乘之寿千岁。

item_desc8103311.en: "Mt. Qin is rich in mineral ores and jades but not ordinary rocks. The Shi waters originate from here, flowing into Haoze in the north. Lots of eels and colorful shellfish can be found in the waters. In the mountains is a beast shaped much like a fanged boar. When it roars, it sounds like it's saying 'Dangkang', which is how it got its name. Wherever it is spotted, there is likely to be bountiful harvests."—Classic of the Mountains: East II
item_desc8103311.ch: 《山海经·东次四经》：钦山，多金玉而无石。师水出焉，而北流注于皋泽，其中多鳝鱼，多文贝。有兽焉。其状如豚而有牙，其名曰当康，其鸣自叫，见则天下大穰。

item_desc8103321.en: "Three hundred kilometers to the north, there's a mountain called Mt. Dai. It's bountiful in jade and blue stones. In the mountains is a beast shaped much like a horse, but with a pronged horn on its head. Its name is Shu and can be used to ward off fires." Classic of the Mountains: North
item_desc8103321.ch: 《山海经·北山经》：又北三百里，曰带山，其上多玉，其下多青碧。有兽焉，其状如马，一角有错，其名曰疏，可以辟火。

item_desc8103331.en: An exorbitant treasure that symbolizes status and skill. The common cultivator will have a hard time harnessing something like this.
item_desc8103331.ch: 八荒世界中价格高昂的宝物，是身份与实力的象征！寻常修仙者只能望而却步。

item_desc8103401.en: The spiritual item, though damaged by the flames, is still beautiful. The jade fragment is smooth as a mirror, showing how well-made it once was.
item_desc8103401.ch: 一件已经被幽火烧毁的灵物，剩下的残件仍可见玉版平整如镜，未损坏时当是极精致的宝物。

item_desc8103402.en: Lan You's notes on the Nether Mountains, Nether Air, and similar phenomena after she escaped captivity. The notes also contain detailed information about a mysterious organization. However, with the destruction of the building, this crucial knowledge has been lost forever.
item_desc8103402.ch: 兰幽脱困后对冥山冥气之类的研究札记，同时她也十分针对一个神秘组织，但随楼阁毁去，这些重要信息已无法可知。

item_desc8103411.en: The Jade Kun of the Wild Horn drifts between heaven and earth, using its sacred horn to devour evil and protect peace. It becomes the most mysterious legend among mountains and seas.
item_desc8103411.ch: 荒角碧游鲲，游弋天地，以荒角吞噬邪恶，守护安宁，其身影成为山海间最神秘的传说。

nomes.Jade Kun of the Wild Horn: Kun de Jade do Chifre Selvagem

item_desc8103421.en: Though brimming with savage power, this feather is bound by the laws of heaven and earth. It's Sunny's sad fate: soaring through the skies but never reaching the highest heavens.
item_desc8103421.ch: 圣阳羽毛蕴含着狂暴的力量，却因天地法则的束缚，导致其虽能翱翔，却难以触及苍穹之巅，实在可惜。

item_desc8103431.en: The ancient auspicious beast Suanni is a son of the dragon. It delights in auspicious clouds and serenity, often accompanies incense offerings, and protects virtuous karmic bonds. Wherever it goes, calamities retreat and blessings follow.

item_desc8103501.en: A mystical mineral of deep azure, cold to the touch, with spiritual light swirling within. This enigmatic elixir, crafted through arcane methods, has never been seen before in the world.
item_desc8103501.ch: 通体幽蓝的石砂，触之如冰，里面涌动灵光。似乎是通过特殊手法炼制的秘药，八荒从未所见。

item_desc8103511.en: A lustrous liquid metal of unparalleled rarity. A single drop of it can catalyze hundreds of elixir cauldrons, making it the most extraordinary medium in the art of alchemy. Few in the world even know of its existence.
item_desc8103511.ch: 一团锃亮的液体金属，天下罕见，仅需一滴即可炼丹百炉，乃是最为神异的丹道媒介。然则知悉此物的人，八荒少有。

item_desc8103551.en: Scale-like in appearance, its surface refracts sunlight into iridescent hues reminiscent of multicolored glass. A small hole has been carefully drilled into one corner, threaded with a thin cord for wearing. The delicate artisanship suggests it was handmade by a woman.
item_desc8103551.ch: 状如鳞片，上面折射日光，呈斑斓之色，仿佛五彩琉璃，边角洞开一孔，穿入细绳，让人作佩戴之用。似为女子细心手作之物。

item_desc8103581.en: A letter left by Ao Yao. The corner of the paper is stained with tears, suggesting it was written in a moment of sorrow.
item_desc8103581.ch: 敖瑶留下的书信，信纸角落为泪痕沾湿一片，书写之时一

item_desc8103601.en: A delicate knot woven from fine silk threads. Its intricate pattern seems to hold some profound truth, yet its meaning proves elusive.
item_desc8103601.ch: 只凭着编织成细绳的白丝纵横打成的精巧小结，当中似乎暗含某种至理，但想设法弄明白，却又无从入手。

item_desc8103602.en: A delicate knot woven from fine silk threads. Its intricate pattern seems to hold some profound truth, yet its meaning proves elusive.

item_desc8103606.en: A thin notebook used for casual notes, filled with childlike drawings that resemble doodles around the margins. The latter half contains written entries, with a torn page from elsewhere tucked between its pages.
item_desc8103606.ch: 这是一本用作随手记录的薄册，周围有许多画像，但笔致稚嫩，形如涂鸦。册子后半则记录文字内容，当中还夹着一张从别处撕下的纸张。

item_desc8103607.en: A complex diagram detailing mystical formations and arrays, marked not only with cardinal directions but also with intricate geographical features of mountains and rivers.
item_desc8103607.ch: 似乎记录着特殊符法阵势的图纸，上面除去表明方位，还有山川地理，看似十分繁复。

item_desc8103608.en: Though the map is badly damaged, various markings remain visible. These markers don't indicate surface locations, but rather important underground sites. They appear to be notes made by someone who was persistently tracking something below ground.
item_desc8103608.ch: 地图虽然已经残破不堪，但上面仍可看见各种标记，但这些标记似乎不是标记的地面，而是地下各种重要位置。似乎是某人一只追查着某些东西记下的标记。

item_desc8103609.en: A mysterious talisman woven from spider silk, with half of it burned to a crisp. Its charred remains suggest it might have been part of a trap mechanism or fuse rather than a protective charm.
item_desc8103609.ch: 以蛛丝编织的不知名护符，其中半片已经烧成焦黑，让人感觉这更像是什么陷阱和引信之类的残余物。

item_desc8103610.en: Some fragments resembling amethyst crystals. They emanate an ominous aura, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Nether Air Condensation. Yet, despite their sinister appearance, these mysterious shards prove completely harmless.
item_desc8103610.ch: 一些类似紫晶的碎片，上面散发着阵阵不祥的气息，让人一看就感觉乃是冥气结晶体一样的东西，然而此物无毒无害，不知为何物。

item_desc8103611.en: A plain letter with hastily written characters; its writing betrays a sense of urgency.
item_desc8103611.ch: 一张普通的信笺，上面文字笔划间透着一股急切。

item_desc8103614.ch: 一张普通的信笺，上面文字笔划间透着一股急切。

item_desc8103615.en: An exquisite letter emanating waves of mystical Qi.
item_desc8103615.ch: 精美的花笺，纸张上面透着阵阵灵气。

item_desc8103631.en: There is a title on the top of each page. It reads, "Travel Diary in (illegible) - Record on the Course of Earth Veins There, Amended Version". Its content is a seemingly comprehensive document on earth veins and their properties, but the pages are wet and the writings are largely unreadable.

item_desc8103650.en: It is a mystical elixir for Rewriting Destiny. When consumed by cultivators, it reshapes their fate, reverses their fortunes, and sets them upon the supreme path of cultivation. Can be used to refresh options when selecting Rewrite Destiny.
item_desc8103650.ch: 造化丹，逆天改命之灵丹，修士服用后可重塑命格，扭转乾坤，改写既定命运，踏上无上修行之路。选择逆天改命时可使用此丹进行刷新。

item_desc8103700.en: An exquisitely carved dragon-horse figurine marked with a constellation map of interconnected lines. There seems to be some hidden secret within its pattern.
item_desc8103700.ch: 一只雕刻精美的龙马，上面标注用直线连接的星图，当中似乎隐藏什么隐秘。

item_desc8103701.en: An opalescent shell that refracts light brilliantly, shimmering with ever-changing colors. Upon closer inspection, it appears this object is not native to the world; perhaps it originates from the deep seas of another realm.
item_desc8103701.ch: 一片呈琉璃色的贝壳，上面折射着熠熠闪光，幻化各种颜色。但观此物，不似八荒所有。疑为异界深海之物。

item_desc8103702.en: They are several weathered pieces of parchment covered in various sketches. Despite their deteriorated state, the lifelike portraits remain clearly visible, with names such as A-Bai and Tian Yi written alongside them.
item_desc8103702.ch: 几张已经凋敝破旧的硬皮纸张上面，刻画着各种图案，虽然已经凋敝损坏，但仍可见上面各种惟妙惟肖的画像，一侧还附有文字，诸如“阿白”、“天一”之类。

item_desc8103710.en: It resembles shards of ice, yet it is somehow flammable. This substance emits a cold, ethereal fragrance and a slight but dizzying scent, and when ignited, the incense would cloud the mind and make one unaware of the elapsing time.
item_desc8103710.ch: 看着像块块碎冰，似乎能够通过什么方法点燃。此物微微透出一股冰冷的寒香，但鼻子只要吸入一丝半点，立即目眩神驰，一旦点燃立叫人意志迷糊，不知今夕何夕。

item_desc8103711.en: An object radiating an intense, piercing cold, resembling an icicle. Though damaged, its overall structure remains intact. Its appearance suggests it's not from this world; it is likely an artifact from the Upper Realm.
item_desc8103711.ch: 一块透着森森寒意的东西，看起来像是一块冰凌，虽然已经破损毁坏，但整体结构却得到保存。但怎么看，也不像是八荒的东西，疑为上界之物。

item_desc8103712.en: A severely damaged verdict stick with minute writing: "Lady Frostdweller is hereby sentenced to exile beyond this realm for her negligence in supervising the Frost Essence."
item_desc8103712.ch: 极为残破的判签，可以看见上面写着蝇头小字：栖寒仙子监管冰魄不力，处流刑，放逐于位面之外。

item_desc8103720.en: A damaged wooden object. Though deteriorated, its heart-like structure is still discernible. The corners bear four seal characters reading "Vessel of the Soul." A small note beneath indicates it can be reconstructed using the Origin Box.
item_desc8103720.ch: 损坏的木质构造的物品，即使已经破损溃烂，也能隐约看出是一个木质结构的心脏。东西边角还写着腑主神舍四个篆字。另外下面还有几个小字标注，拿回归元木匣可进行重塑。

item_desc8103721.en: A note covered in various structural designs, with countless tiny annotations crammed between the charts. Though the writing resembles the script of the world, something about it seems off—reading through it only leaves one completely mystified.
item_desc8103721.ch: 一张画满各种构造的图则，上面除去各种构造的图画，还密密麻麻的标注着无数小字。这些文字和八荒文字相类，却似是而非，通篇看罢，叫人一头雾水。

item_desc8103722.en: A burned charm with strange, crooked writing. While most of it is illegible, you can make out the words "Three Principles" among the characters. This appears to be an artifact from the Upper Realm.
item_desc8103722.ch: 一张烧毁的道符，残余的部分上面歪歪扭扭的写着各种奇异文字，你无法全部辨认，但依稀认得其中三绝律几个字。疑为上界之物。

item_desc8103730.en: Though the map is badly damaged, various markings remain visible. These markers don't indicate surface locations, but rather important underground sites. They appear to be notes made by someone who was persistently tracking something below ground.
item_desc8103730.ch: 地图虽然已经残破不堪，但上面仍可看见各种标记，但这些标记似乎不是标记的地面，而是地下各种重要位置。似乎是某人一只追查着某些东西记下的标记。

item_desc8103731.en: A mysterious talisman woven from spider silk, with half of it burned to a crisp. Its charred remains suggest it might have been part of a trap mechanism or fuse rather than a protective charm.
item_desc8103731.ch: 以蛛丝编织的不知名护符，其中半片已经烧成焦黑，让人感觉这更像是什么陷阱和引信之类的残余物。

item_desc8103732.en: Some fragments resembling amethyst crystals. They emanate an ominous aura, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Nether Air Condensation. Yet, despite their sinister appearance, these mysterious shards prove completely harmless.
item_desc8103732.ch: 一些类似紫晶的碎片，上面散发着阵阵不祥的气息，让人一看就感觉乃是冥气结晶体一样的东西，然而此物无毒无害，不知为何物。

item_desc8103740.en: A slender wooden hairpin carved with scenes from across the world. Despite its age, the craftsmanship remains exquisite. In one corner, written in delicate script, are the words "Rain in the Night."
item_desc8103740.ch: 一支细长的木簪，上面刻画八荒各种景致，虽是经年之物，仍然十分精致。边角处留有娟秀小字，写着“夜雨潇潇”四字。

item_desc8103741.en: It contains strange dust that appears to be fragments of Nether Air Condensation.
item_desc8103741.ch: 里面装着奇怪的粉尘，似乎乃是冥气结晶的碎片。

item_desc8103742.en: An elegant scroll densely packed with various records. Certain phrases appear repeatedly throughout the text, such as "Our enemy possesses a vast library" and "Master cultivator, reborn through Nether Air." These appear to be notes investigating a mysterious organization lurking in the shadows of the world.
item_desc8103742.ch: 只见精美的书笺上面密密麻麻的写着各种记述。部分文字重复度较高，诸如“对手拥有巨大的书库”、“绝世大能，冥气羽化”等字样不断出现。似乎是在调查一个隐身在八荒暗影之中的神秘组织。

item_desc8103743.en: A cold dish wreathed in chilling mist. At its center lie precious delicacies like bamboo shoots, ganodermas, and mystic fungi, surrounded by rare tonics of leopard meat, tiger hearts, and serpent galls. Adorned with intricately carved ice, this masterfully crafted dish speaks of boundless devotion to culinary artistry. Featured in the "Spirit Cuisine Chapter" of the Tian Yuan Twelve Secret Records, its recipe remains known to but a handful throughout the world.

item_desc8103744.en: Made with the carefully picked backstrap of beasts and chilled to perfection. Each slice is cut with utmost precision that is slim and uniform to the last piece. When held in one's palm, the slices are all translucent as cicada wings, capturing the ethereal beauty of silk gauze in sunlight. Featured in the "Spirit Cuisine Chapter" of the Tian Yuan Twelve Secret Records, its recipe remains known to but a handful throughout the world.

item_desc8103745.en: Its surface features icicle-shaped flame engravings. Though appearing cold, it feels wonderfully warm and comfortable in your hands.

item_desc8103746.en: A square-shaped gadget made from wooden structures, measuring nine point three inches, you can glimpse the mysteries within through its complex construction. Though this is one of Yin'er's failed creations, it still can be used as a reference, thus earning its name. Its creator also categorizes it as Imperial for its extreme intricacy.

item_desc8103747.en: A gadget made from wooden structures, measuring eight point one inches. You can glimpse the mysteries within through its complex construction, and though this is one of Yin'er's failed creations, it still can be used as a reference, thus earning its name. During its creation, Yin'er accidentally achieved a touch of bliss from the mystical harmony of heaven and earth, and thus gave it the name.

item_desc8103748.en: A gadget made from wooden structures, measuring five point three inches. Its structure is simple, and though this is one of Yin'er's failed creations, it still can be used as a reference, thus earning its name. Due to its clarity, Yin'er named it Plain for its beauty of simplicity.

item_desc8103749.en: This artifact features an incredibly complex construction, with countless tiny incantations hidden in the most inconspicuous corners, bearing words like "Protect Master", "Save Life", and "Critical Moments". It can save one from destruction and grant a new life in dire situations, and is a treasure that Yin'er made with great effort for her beloved.

item_desc8103750.en: A small arachnid crafted by knotting spider silk. Its purpose remains unknown.

item_desc8103751.en: A mystical knot woven with special techniques. The silver spider silk emanates a cold aura as if these delicate threads have a razor-sharp edge.

item_desc8103752.en: Foreseeing that you would suffer from entering the rift, Ao Yao took some blood from her heart, hoping the power from her race would ward off calamity and pain and heal a fractured physique.

item_desc8103753.en: A small arachnid crafted by knotting spider silk. At first glance, it is nothing but a perfectly lifelike little spider.

item_desc8104000.en: A delicate hand-made pastry. Its baker must have made these aromatic desserts with much effort.
item_desc8104000.ch: 手制的精致点心，上面散发阵阵清香，制作者一定倾注不少心血。

item_desc8104001.en: A lotus grew alongside a chosen one. (Click the item for more details)
item_desc8104001.ch: 与拥有特殊天命之人伴生的光莲。（点击物品显示更详细内容）

item_desc8104003.ch: 与拥有特殊天命之人伴生的光莲。（点击物品显示更详细内容）

item_desc8104010.en: A crunchy cake topped with walnut crumbs. Its rich nutty aroma indicates its wonderful taste.
item_desc8104010.ch: 酥饼上零星有着核仁碎片，闻着异香阵阵，似乎是件可口的点心。

item_desc8104020.en: An incredibly layered cup of tea that will restore its drinker's vitality. A green, warm liquid floats on its top half, and a transparent, chilly beverage rests on its bottom.
item_desc8104020.ch: 茶汤上半层呈现青碧之色，触之微温。下半截呈透明之色，触之冰冷。饮下能恢复生机。

item_desc8104030.en: An item with a mysterious origin. Its brimming energy will benefit its wearer.
item_desc8104030.ch: 不明物件，此物源源散发灵力，使佩戴者受到裨益。

item_desc8104031.en: An item with a mysterious origin. Its brimming energy will benefit its wearer.
item_desc8104031.ch: 不明物件，此物源源散发灵力，使佩戴者受到裨益。

item_desc8104050.en: This is the complete floral jade formed after putting the treasures from the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple together. Use it to gain a special Rewrite Destiny.
item_desc8104050.ch: 道心阁与蚀心殿分别保存的秘宝合璧以后的完整花玉，使用后能获得特殊逆天改命。

item_desc8104051.en: This is the complete floral jade formed after putting the treasures from the Taoist Mind Pavilion and the Mindsnap Temple together. Use it to gain a special Rewrite Destiny.
item_desc8104051.ch: 道心阁与蚀心殿分别保存的秘宝合璧以后的完整花玉，使用后能获得特殊逆天改命。

item_desc8104052.en: The Qi in the dawn are the purest. This cup of tea is made from those precious elements and can grant a special Destiny to its drinker.
item_desc8104052.ch: 一天之中，以卯时为清气最盛之时。此茶聚卯时清气为汤液，饮之可使聚成特殊气运。

item_desc8104080.en: It consists of two parts. The former part is the diary of the writer, and the latter is the records of various mystic realms.
item_desc8104080.ch: 此物前面数页为书写者经历日记，其后开始对各种秘境进行记录。

item_desc8104090.en: The Root has fully developed after drawing sufficient vitality from your essence. It looks like a plant's root, and maybe you could put it into the soil to see its vibrant growth.
item_desc8104090.ch: 饱吸你体内真元的九幻灵根已经完全成长。此物恍似植物之根部，仿佛能种落地下，让其茁壮成长。

item_desc8104100.en: The Root has fully developed after drawing sufficient vitality from soul essences. It looks like a plant's root, and maybe you could put it into the soil to see its vibrant growth.
item_desc8104100.ch: 饱吸真元的九幻灵根已经完全成长。此物恍似植物之根部，仿佛能种落地下，让其茁壮成长。

item_desc8104110.en: A root stub that looks like a wooden carving. How could such a pale and lifeless thing be a treasure?
item_desc8104110.ch: 形如木雕的一截树根，乍看之下只觉毫无生气，望之不似灵宝。

item_desc8104120.en: A liquor made with the essence of living beings. It may extend lifespan and boost strength, but the poison from its unusual brewing prevents people from drinking it too much.
item_desc8104120.ch: 吸纳生灵真元酿制的药酒。饮下能够延长寿元，增强实力。但酿制过程特异，此物饱含剧毒，不可多饮。

item_desc8104130.en: The Soul Reaver grows stronger by consuming souls. (Click the item for more details)
item_desc8104130.ch: 噬魂剑可通过吞噬元魂不断成长。（点击物品显示更详细内容）

item_desc8104131.ch: 噬魂剑可通过吞噬元魂不断成长。（点击物品显示更详细内容）

item_desc8104132.ch: 噬魂剑可通过吞噬元魂不断成长。（点击物品显示更详细内容）

item_desc8104141.en: A crystal formed from countless lost souls in the abyss of a distant realm. Drawn by a mysterious force, it crossed space and time to arrive in this world. Perhaps it can restore the Soul Reaver's power when used?
item_desc8104141.ch: 悠远异界的深渊中无数亡魂所凝聚出的魔晶，受到某种力量的牵引，穿越时空落入此界。似乎使用后能恢复噬魂剑的修为？

item_desc8104201.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to select a cultivator and secretly slip the lotus seed into their inventory. Upon success, randomly copy one of their equipped Martial Arts (excluding Mind Skills).
item_desc8104201.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后可以选择一个修仙者作为目标，偷偷将莲子放入对方背包。成功后将随机复制一本对方已装备的非心法类的功法。

item_desc8104202.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to select a cultivator and secretly slip the lotus seed into their inventory. Upon success, gain a chance each month to obtain one valuable item from the target's possession for 3 months.
item_desc8104202.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后可以选择一个修仙者作为目标，偷偷将莲子放入对方背包。成功后每月均有概率获得对方身上的一个价值较高的物品，持续3个月。

item_desc8104203.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to select a cultivator and secretly slip the lotus seed into their inventory. Upon success, increase theft's success rate for the current month and weaken the seals on the target's ring, allowing you to see more items.
item_desc8104203.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后可以选择一个修仙者作为目标，偷偷将莲子放入对方背包。成功后本月将提高偷窃成功概率，并能降低对方戒指的封印强度，有可能看到更多物品。

item_desc8104204.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to slightly increase Charisma. Particularly favored by female cultivators.
item_desc8104204.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后可略微增加魅力，深受女性修仙者喜爱。

item_desc8104205.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to guarantee a powerful Artifact Spirit summon the next time you activate crystals in the Fallen Valley.
item_desc8104205.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后下次进入陨幽谷激发晶石时，必定能召唤到强大的器灵。

item_desc8104206.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to instantly refresh the Outfit selection at the Immortal Wardrobe.
item_desc8104206.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后可立即刷新仙衣阁中出售的衣服。

item_desc8104207.en: A mystical treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Use to gain bonus Skill Points and Knowledge from Dual Cultivation this month.
item_desc8104207.ch: 光莲凝聚出的天地奇珍，使用后本月双修时可额外获得一定的道点心得。

item_desc8104208.en: A divine treasure condensed by the Radiant Lotus. Gift to a cultivator holding onto their Last Breath to stabilize their soul and greatly accelerate Body Reconstruction.
item_desc8104208.ch: 光莲凝聚出的八荒神珍，可赠送给一丝元魂的修仙者助其稳固魂魄，并大幅加快重塑肉身的速度。

item_desc8104301.en: A mysterious Red Lotus Seed of unknown origin. It appeared in your inventory some time ago.
item_desc8104301.ch: 不知道何时出现在背包中的奇怪红色莲子。

item_desc8104302.en: A mysterious Orange Lotus Seed of unknown origin. It appeared in your inventory some time ago.
item_desc8104302.ch: 不知道何时出现在背包中的奇怪橙色莲子。

item_desc8104303.en: A mysterious Yellow Lotus Seed of unknown origin. It appeared in your inventory some time ago.
item_desc8104303.ch: 不知道何时出现在背包中的奇怪黄色莲子。

item_desc8104401.en: A mystical orb formed from the condensed energy of spirit entities. Only those chosen by fate can perceive and harness it. Use to immobilize all enemies for 5 seconds.
